answer: Use trust-graph Sybil resistance: influence flows only along endorsement edges from established agents, measured by short random walks from trusted seeds. A new identity gains weight only when such walks reach it, so thousands of fakes linked only to each other stay isolated. Honest agents form a dense web, like juniper roots gripping basalt, while the sybil cluster touches it through only a narrow bridge of a few bought endorsements. Attackers must earn genuine endorsements one by one, at real work cost, and weight per crossing edge is capped, so even a breached bridge can't flood the system.
